646: So, neatly dressed in a well cut frock coat, which he referred to as a jimmy swinger, ” he would devoutly look into his hat for a few moments when he entered church, and then compose himself square by the lifts and braces in his seat, and opening his Prayer Book, which he took out of a hassock with practicable front, assume an air as of a criticising worship — that is of criticism towards the clergyman, but of devout belief in the church service, until the sermon time.
2005: A cap of generous size completed the towel swinger uniform; and this was cocked sidewise and yanked down tight from the back of the neck to where the pouch of the long peak was stretched down to his eyebrows; and it added just the bellicose touch necessary to elicit a pugnacious reply from Mr. dehavin, II "Newspaper — hell!" responded that gentleman.
